native_mechanisms: Two rows on a shared track, one fixed, the other allowed exactly one forward slip — every slip position tried plus the no-slip case
Per-house comparison marking match (lotus petal) vs mismatch (red knot), one house per flute beat, no skipping or double-counting
Each trial's mismatch marks gathered and counted, all trials but the lowest-count one discarded, that count being the answer
core_technique: Banded anti-diagonal (wavefront) Needleman-Wunsch with AVX2 32-bit lanes, where the band half-width comes from an O(n) prefix/suffix-scan lower bound over all zero- and one-gap alignments (plus a probe-band re-tightening), falling back to two-row NW for small/failed cases
